Yuvraj Singh's T20 Six Sixes Record Anniversary Marked

The 16th anniversary of Yuvraj Singh's record of hitting six consecutive sixes in a single over during the 2007 T20 World Cup against England was observed. Yuvraj achieved this feat against bowler Stuart Broad, scoring 58 runs off 16 balls, including a half-century in just 12 deliveries. This performance was a significant moment in India's victory in that match and the subsequent tournament.
